author: Mehrp
body: Personally, I feel that players needing to sign up and go on github seems a bit of hassle, how abouts a place on the forums where you submit glitches and only sr mods and admins can see and reply to threads. What do you guys think?
body_tagged: Personally, I feel that players needing to sign up and go on github seems a bit of hassle, how abouts a place on the forums where you submit glitches and only sr mods and admins can see and reply to threads. What do you guys think?
title: [SUG] glitch threads

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
I don't think that only senior moderators and admins would know how to fix them. A lot are map issues so map developers would need permission as well and some might get feedback from other members in the community because they can help in some cases.

Really since theres a good organized github repository I don't see a need to have a forum if players know how to use github. Being lazy and not registering is a different thing.

As for learning it its not hard and can be done in minutes to create a simple issue in the repository so really not needed, would be better for newer players though.
